original: No, we haven't been able to find\nher.
Really? I wonder where she went.
At the Gekomon castle. I thought\nit might have been a dream, but...
I have a feeling...the voice that\ntold me not to eat the mushrooms\nwas also Sora's.
But why isn't Sora showing herself\nto us?
Worrying about it won't solve\nanything. We have to find her in\nthe flesh first.
Not good! Flymon are real fast!
If Birdramon is here, then so is\nSora!
The night Piyomon and I left to\nlook for Taichi, I saw them.
Everyone's Crests have a meaning.\nFor example, Taichi has the Crest\nof Courage...
You have the Crest of Hope.
Koushirou has the Crest of\nKnowledge, Jou has the Crest of\nHonesty...
Mimi has the Crest of Purity, and\nI...have the Crest of Love.
Huh. The Crest of Love suits you,\nSora.
No, it doesn't! It doesn't suit me\nat all!
But Sora, you're always worrying\nabout us...
I don't care about everyone! You\ndon't know what I'm *really* like!
Because I don't have any love.
What do you mean, you don't have\nany love?
PicoDevimon said that I was raised\nwithout any real love...
He said, because of that, my Crest\nwill never glow!
Don't be silly. PicoDevimon was\njust lying.
It's not a lie. When I was on the\ngirls' soccer team...
I was injured, but no matter how\nmuch I asked, my mother wouldn't \nlet me go to an important match.
She only sees me as the daughter\nof a flower arrangement school\nhead.
So if I grew up without love, I\ncan't do anything about that!
But even if that's true, you can't\njust believe everything\nPicoDevimon says!
H-hey, Yamato. What am I supposed\nto do at a time like this?
If she wants to cry, let her cry.
Thank you, Sora. You were secretly\nhelping us, weren't you?
She knew PicoDevimon was up to\nsomething, so she decided to help\nyou in secret.
So, don't leave us anymore. I\ndon't want my family...
I mean, I don't want everyone to\nsplit up.
Things have calmed down a bit.
You're our friend no matter what
Your Crest will surely glow someday
Even if your Crest doesn't glow,\nSora, you're still our friend.
Thanks, but then how are we gonna\nsave the world?
We'll all think of a way.
Your Crest will glow someday,\nSora. I'm sure of it.
Haha! It's weird for you to say\nthings like "I'm sure of it".
My intuition's always right on the\nmark, you know.
I get the feeling your Crest will\nglow, too.
Sora's been deep in thought over\nthere.
Yeah, she's dealing with a lot of\nstuff.
Yeah! She's just a bit tired.
Your words cheered her up, Takeru!
I just said what I was thinking.
I have to do something impressive\nbefore Lord Vamdemon gets here!
You can't, not in that state!
I know, Sora, but I have to go!
Those are...the words I said to my\nmother back then....
My mother...was putting me before\neverything else...
I can feel the depths of Sora's\nlove!
Aaaaargh! The Crest of Love just\nhad to activate at the worst\npossible time!
The sun will be rising soon.\nYou've barely escaped, children...
I realized, I...was acting exactly\nlike my mother.
And then I realized that my mother\nreally does love me.
Aaaah, I want Sora's love, too.
Y-you idiot! Taichi, you can't\njust *say* that!
Huh? Jou, your face is red.
Jou, I'll give you my love, too.
Hey, old man. What do you want\nthis time?
Well, I've got good news and bad\nnews. Which do you want to hear?
We're going to be disappointed\nanyway, so let's hear the good\nnews.
Then here's the good news. I've\nfound a comrade for you.
A comrade? You mean a Chosen\nChild?
Yes. In truth, there are actually\neight Chosen Children.
You can't fix the distortions in \nthis world unless all eight of you \nare together.
And the distortions will affect\nyour world as well. Understand?
I wonder what kind of person they\nare.
So where are they? What's their\nname?
As for their name... I don't know!
But I do know where they are.\nThey're in Japan.
Ah, right, you've been there\nbefore, Agumon.
Vamdemon already knows about what\nI just said, and he's heading to\nJapan to reach them first.
He's raising an army so that he\ncan find and kill the child.
There should be a gate leading to\nJapan in Vamdemon's castle.
I'm counting on you to stop his\nplans and protect your comrade...
